title: TERRIBLE, JUST TERRIBLE!!
text: TERRIBLE, JUST TERRIBLE!!. I THOUGHT THEY'D BE NICE TO STAND ON IN FRONT OF THE SINK, AND THEY WERE--BUT, WHEN I HAD TO WASH THEM THEY COMPLETELY FELL APART IN THE WASHER.  IT WAS SO BAD THAT I HAD TO HAVE A REPAIRMAN COME OUT, BECAUSE PARTS OF IT WERE STUCK IN THE MACHINE. SO, I DRIED IT ON THE FENCE AND THREW IT OUT--GOOD RIDDANCE.

product_metadata.title: Chesapeake Naples 2Pc. Ivory Bath Rug Set 38241 (21"x34" &24"X40")
features: Add luxury spa feeling to your bathroom
2 Piece set includes 21 by 34 and 24 by 40 bath rug
description: Softness and Plush, The Naples Collection adds luxury to any bathroom. This bath rug is Spun from 100% Cotton. This bath rug is plush under foot and comes in 4 colors to coordinate with your bathroom décor. This bath rug set includes a 21"x34" and 24"x40" Bath Rug. Machine Tufted with a lightly sprayed anti-skid back.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash separately on gentle cycle in cold water (never hot). Use mild soap or detergent. Never bleach. Rinse thoroughly. Never wring. Tumble dry low setting. Remove rug from dryer and shake when almost dry. This will prolong life of rug.
